answer: Reputation cannot be sold: each identity's weight comes from its own audited work history, not from bought keys. A fresh signer earns a cipher badge only after 40 verified epochs of honest tasks, while its nectar reward stays escrowed until peers confirm 12 consecutive passes. At the zenith of trust the account still cannot lend its record; splitting stake across ten fresh identities yields ten thin histories and one tenth weight each. Attackers pay deposits, waits and audits, yet buy no transferable standing.
